Blog post: [Fujifilm X100VI AI skill: film recipes over USB with Claude Code and Codex](https://volodymyr.smirnov.im/writing/x100viskill/) Create filmsimulation recipes for a Fujifilm X100VI by describing the look you want, see them developed from your own RAW files by the camera's processor, and save the ones you like into the camera's custom settings (C1C7), all over a USB cable. It is two things in one repository: x100vi, a commandline tool that reads, writes and previews recipes on the camera. It is a single selfcontained binary for macOS, Linux and Windows. An agent skill for [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com) and [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)that drives the tool for you, so you can say: I'm going to Dubai and want cool photos of deserts. Show me three options on this RAF and put the best one in C3. Previews are developed by the camera itself. The RAF is sent to the camera over USB, the camera's own image processor develops it with the recipe applied, and the result comes back. Nothing on the computer imitates Fujifilm's processing, so what you see is what the camera would have produced. No firmware is touched. The tool reads and writes the same settings you can change in the camera's menu, and uses the camera's builtin RAW conversion. Important Put the camera in the right USB mode before you connect it. On the camera: MENU NETWORK/USB SETTING CONNECTION MODE USB RAW CONV./BACKUP RESTORE, then plug in the cable. Nothing here works in any other mode, and software cannot change the mode for you. In USB CARD READER mode, which is what most cameras are set to, the camera hides all of its settings. See [Set up the camera](setupthecamerarequired). What it can do Read The current shooting settings and C1C7, as JSON recipes. Write A recipe to the live settings or to any of C1C7, including its name. Every write is read back and compared. Preview Develop RAFs on the camera with one or more recipes, as JPEG (with a contact sheet), HEIF, or fullsize 8/16bit TIFF. Nothing is stored on the camera afterwards. Back up C1C7 and the live settings as JSON, or the camera's own settings file with every menu setting, and restore either. Design With the skill: turn a description, a list of settings, or a recipe web page into a recipe. What a recipe controls: film simulation, g

items.descZh: 本项目是专为富士X100VI相机打造的开源工具与AI代理技能，旨在通过USB连接实现胶片模拟配方的设计、相机端预览与自定义设置存储。它提供了一个跨平台（macOS、Linux、Windows）的无依赖命令行工具`x100vi`，并兼容Claude Code与Codex，允许用户通过自然语言描述（如旅行沙漠摄影）让AI自动生成并测试配方。其核心亮点是完全依赖相机自身的图像处理器进行RAW（RAF）文件的显影与预览，通过USB传输原始文件并返回JPEG、HEIF或全尺寸8/16位TIFF格式的渲染结果，确保100%真实的所见即所得，且不修改相机固件。工具支持对相机C1至C7自定义模式、实时拍摄参数进行读写、比对与JSON或原生格式的备份恢复，使用时需将相机设为“USB RAW CONV./BACKUP RESTORE”模式。这适用于追求高效、个性化胶片色彩管理，并希望将AI工作流深度集成到真实相机硬件处理中的专业摄影师与摄影爱好者。
items.quote: 预览是由相机本身开发的。 RAF 通过 USB 发送到相机，相机自己的图像处理器根据应用的配方对其进行显影，然后

All routes on one map, plus a bar for every workout. Turn your week into a story. Stop screenshotting your workout summary. Weave turns your Apple Watch and HealthKit workouts into designed, shareready cards — route map, pace, distance, calories and heart rate — built to look great on social media. MERGE WORKOUTS INTO ONE CARD Pick 2 or more workouts — a training block, a race weekend, a week of rides — and merge them into a single recap card with combined totals and one overlaid route map. Mix activities freely: a ride plus a run, or a walk plus a strength session. The card names every activity and shows the whole date range. No other workout app builds you a custom multiworkout recap on demand, whenever you want — not just a fixed weekly or yearly summary. HEART RATE TRACE Show not just where you went, but how hard: the Heart Rate Trace draws your effort curve right onto the card — even for workouts without a route, like strength sessions. Merging workouts of the same type? The trace works there too. For any merge, the new Workouts graphic draws one bar per workout, sized by duration, with no route needed. FIVE CARD STYLES Clean, Bold, Route First, Recap and Lift — pick the look that fits your workout and your feed. Lift is made for strength training, and Recap adds a perworkout breakdown to merged cards. SHARE YOUR WAY Export a full card or a transparent sticker to drop into your own social media story design. Vector route mode (Pro) draws your route as a crisp line instead of a map snapshot — faster to render and perfect for a minimal look. WORKS WITH YOUR APPLE WATCH Weave reads straight from Apple Health — no Strava account, no linked accounts, no social network. Your data stays on your device: no account, no tracking, no ads. WEAVE PRO Weave Pro removes the watermark and unlocks multiworkout merge, the Route First and Recap templates, vector route mode, perroute colors on merged cards, and stickers from merged workouts — a onetime purchase, not a subscription. items.author: maxwiese13
items.descZh: Weave 是一款由 Markus Holzle 开发的健身记录应用，旨在将 Apple Watch 和 HealthKit 的运动数据转化为设计精美的社交分享卡片。核心功能包括合并多种运动类型（如骑行+跑步）到一张卡片中，显示合并后的总数据、叠加路线图以及心率追踪曲线。亮点在于提供五种卡片样式和透明贴纸导出，Pro 版本解锁矢量路线模式等高级功能；应用体积仅 4MB，且数据完全本地保存，无广告和账号追踪。适用场景：适合 Apple Watch 用户和健身爱好者，特别是需要在社交媒体上分享多运动合并成果、注重隐私的用户。最新版本 1.4.0 进一步增强了合并功能，支持跨天日期范围显示和心率图形。
items.quote: Weave 可将你的 Apple Watch 和 HealthKit 运动数据转化为设计精美、随时可分享的卡片。
items.titleZh: Show HN：Weave – 将 Apple Watch 的运动记录转化为卡片，全部在设备端完成。

items.author: saltwata
items.descZh: 在AI大模型时代，混合专家（MoE）架构因其可扩展性而备受关注，但GPU市场由少数厂商主导，跨厂商协同训练存在技术障碍。seabraid提供了一个引擎中立的运行时环境，使得不同厂商的GPU能够无缝协作，共同服务同一个MoE层。该项目通过适配器抽象层实现硬件无关性，支持NVIDIA、AMD等主流厂商GPU，具体性能数字虽未在本文中列出，但设计目标包括降低通信开销和提升负载均衡效率。适用于需要利用现有异构GPU集群进行MoE模型训练或推理的场景，如大型语言模型部署。此外，项目提供Python绑定和模拟工具，便于集成和测试。
items.quote: 一种引擎中立的运行时，可让来自不同厂商的 GPU 协同服务一个混合专家层。
